svg.title: Invariant translators in the Heisenberg group
svg.desc: Rotational leading-term coordinate model in Nil₃, with g_λ stated. Three vertical translations illustrate the motion. The parabolic profile is an asymptote, not the exact bowl; the other invariant families are described in the text.
svg.text: Common spatial scale · teal: profile / slice · rust: second piece / asymptote · gray: reference geometry
